title: Cosmic Veil Portrait
description: A surreal profile portrait of a woman with elaborate red and purple headdress, facing right, set against a vibrant cosmic background of swirling patterns, translucent bubbles, and draped ethereal curtains in magenta, teal, and violet. The lower portion features geometric symbols and checkerboard patterns on a decorative border.
prompt: Surreal cosmic portrait of a regal woman in profile facing right, wearing an elaborate flowing headdress with red and purple patterns, set within swirling organic forms and draped curtains of vibrant magenta, teal and violet. Translucent bubbles float throughout the scene, with geometric symbols and checkerboard details along the bottom border, psychedelic flowing lines, dreamlike ethereal atmosphere, rich vibrant colors, detailed digital painting.
